What the team handles

We do the work that keeps outbound moving.

Your sales leaders can stay focused on deals. We handle the lists, calls, follow up, coaching, and reporting.

ICP and account targeting

We turn your ideal customer into a clear list of accounts, segments, territories, and buyer roles.

Contact research and hygiene

We find the right people, fill the gaps, remove stale records, and keep the list usable.

Human led prospecting

The rep uses phone, email, and LinkedIn with a message that fits the buyer and market.

Qualification

The rep learns enough about fit, timing, need, and context before passing the conversation to your team.

Meeting setting

We schedule the meeting, confirm it, and make sure your team gets the context.

Follow up

We keep following up when the conversation deserves more than one attempt.

Management and coaching

We review the calls and numbers, coach the rep, and step in when the work slips.

Reporting and changes

We track what happens and adjust the target, message, and approach based on what we learn.

Built to represent your company

Your rep should sound like they understand the account.

The goal is not more dials for the sake of it. It is better conversations with the people your company should be talking to.

Frequently asked

Outsourced SDR questions

Straight answers about what the team does and how we manage it.

Is outreach only by phone?

Phone is a core strength, but the team can also use email and LinkedIn based on the market, buyer, and conversation.

Do SDRs use a fixed script?

We prepare the rep with a clear message and call framework, but we do not expect them to read a generic script. They need to listen and respond to the person on the other end.

Who builds the target account and contact lists?

We handle the account and contact research, list maintenance, segmentation, and cleanup around the ideal customer profile we agree on together.

What happens when an SDR is underperforming?

We coach the rep, review the calls and numbers, and take action when the work is not where it needs to be. We also handle replacement when necessary.

How are meetings handled after they are booked?

The team books and confirms the meeting, records useful context, supports the handoff, and tracks what happens afterward.
